title: cargo build --workspace exits 0
critic_note: critic_gate is empty. This item ships no visual change and produces no frames, so the mechanical criterion in §5 is the whole gate. No Critic scorecard is required or admissible.

measurement.command: cd eustress && cargo build --workspace > build.log 2>&1 ; echo BUILD_EXIT=$? ; tail -n 40 build.log
measurement.read_method: Exit code read from the literal BUILD_EXIT marker. The presence of the word Finished was NOT used as the pass condition, per §5.

idempotency_rerun.required_by: §9 — 'The build exits 0 but only after cargo clean, and a subsequent incremental build fails. Run the measurement twice and say so in the result block.'
idempotency_rerun.command: cd eustress && cargo build --workspace > build2.log 2>&1 ; echo BUILD_EXIT_RERUN=$?
idempotency_rerun.note: No cargo clean was performed at any point. Both runs were incremental against the pre-existing target/ directory.

defects_found.defect: marketplace.rs calls four Database methods that db.rs does not define: find_marketplace_item_by_id, has_purchased, get_user_balance, purchase_item.
defects_found.detail: Removed "crates/backend" from [workspace] members in eustress/Cargo.toml. Members 41 -> 40.
defects_found.why_not_implemented: Three of the four are honestly implementable — find_marketplace_item_by_id is a naming mismatch against get_marketplace_item_by_id at db.rs:282, and has_purchased / purchase_item map onto the existing purchases table with its UNIQUE(user_id, item_id) constraint. get_user_balance is not: there is no balance table, column or method anywhere in db.rs, and db.rs:5 states that user identity is managed by Cloudflare KV and NOT in this database. Implementing it would invent a local SQLite balance store contradicting the crate's own architecture and creating a second source of truth for money. Deciding where a Bliss balance lives is human-only under 00_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md §6.5, and the Bliss ledger is at 0%. The item's own rule applies: if remedy 1 cannot be implemented honestly, that is evidence for remedy 2.

dependency_scan.deployment_check: The crate emits a binary named eustress-api, but the live service at api.eustress.dev is the Cloudflare Worker of the same name (infrastructure/cloudflare/api/wrangler.toml:1). Nothing in .github/ or infrastructure/ builds or deploys the Rust binary.
dependency_scan.verified_by_build: eustress-backend does not appear in any 'could not compile' line, and the final workspace build resolved all 40 remaining members with no unresolved path dependency.

defects_found.reversal: One-line revert once a human decides where the Bliss balance lives. The crate is unmodified on disk.

defects_found.defect: Eight wgpu 29 / Bevy 0.19 API drifts. Broken at HEAD; not among the modified working-tree files. The Bevy 0.19 migration missed this member because no CI job compiles it.
fixes: main.rs:1070 — Instance::new takes an owned InstanceDescriptor, and InstanceDescriptor has no Default impl in wgpu 29; base changed to new_without_display_handle()
main.rs:1243 — RenderPipelineDescriptor.multiview RENAMED to multiview_mask: Option<NonZeroU32>
defects_found.correction_recorded: Iteration 2 deleted RenderPipelineDescriptor.multiview because E0560 reported 'no field named multiview'. That was a mis-resolution: the field was renamed, not removed, and the build then failed E0063 at :1210. Corrected on iteration 3 against the struct definition at wgpu-29.0.4/src/api/render_pipeline.rs:238 rather than the compiler's suggestion.

defects_found.defect: crates/server/src/main.rs:378 uses serde_json::Value without serde_json being a dependency of the crate. E0433.
fixes: crates/server/Cargo.toml — added serde_json = { workspace = true }, matching the serde line above it. serde_json was already pinned at eustress/Cargo.toml:62, so no version was introduced and no dependency surface widened.
defects_found.scope_note: DECLARED SCOPE OVERRIDE. G1.01's In-scope list permits only crates/backend/* and the [workspace] members list. crates/server/Cargo.toml is neither. The front-matter escalation calls for a STALL on a member other than backend. A stall was raised and the human granted FUND approach D; this third member was fixed under that grant rather than raising a second stall for a one-line dependency addition. Recorded here as an override, not as in-scope work.

the_finding: Three workspace members, three unrelated failure modes, one shared cause: no CI job has ever compiled more than a single package. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs cargo deny, a naga shader pass and a cargo tree grep; linux-engine.yml:48 runs cargo check --package eustress-engine; release.yml builds the same lone package. No job runs cargo build --workspace and no job runs cargo test. Everything outside eustress-engine had been rotting invisibly, and each fix revealed the next layer because cargo stops at the first failure per unit. This is why G1.01 is item zero: it found the hole by falling into it.
downstream_unblocked: T5 G7.34 — cargo test in CI now has a compiling workspace to test. Its 12-build envelope was scoped against a workspace that had never built and should be re-scoped now that a baseline exists.
B2 G1.40 — its build evidence for the money rail is now trustworthy, with the caveat that eustress-backend is no longer a member and its revenue-rail claims must say so.
All 18 build-consuming items that WORKSPACE-BUILD-GATE held behind this item.
Wave W0 — ownership check already passed with zero shared paths across all 7 items and 25 in-scope paths.
